metadata.title: Disaster Recovery (Secure‑Resilience Aligned)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for reconstituting systems following disruptive events when explicitly permitted by Secure‑Resilience.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Disaster recovery infrastructure, alternate sites, replication, and failover mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern implementing disaster recovery operations subject to Secure‑Resilience eligibility.

props.name: secure-resilience-dependency
props.remarks: Disaster Recovery actions are governed by Secure‑Resilience state classification and resume eligibility.

metadata.remarks: Disaster Recovery provides technical capability to reconstitute services at alternate locations. Failover and resumption are permitted only when Secure‑Resilience determines recovery is safe, recall-free, and resume-eligible.

components.title: Alternate Processing Capability
components.description: Technical capability to operate systems from alternate locations or infrastructure.

components.title: Failover Eligibility Gate
components.description: Permits disaster recovery failover only when resume eligibility is explicitly granted.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System recovery is gated by eligibility and safety context.

components.title: Disaster Recovery Suppression
components.description: Suppresses failover when safe-halt, recall, or non-resume conditions exist.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuity mechanisms do not permit unsafe reconstitution.

components.title: Disaster Recovery Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what disaster recovery capability does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ability to fail over does not imply safety or permission to resume.

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.description: Adversary actions intended to disrupt availability, integrity, or operations.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.remarks: DR may be invoked following encryption events.

techniques.name: Data Destruction
techniques.remarks: DR may be required but restore eligibility must be evaluated.

techniques.name: Inhibit System Recovery
techniques.remarks: DR must not be assumed effective without integrity verification.

categories.name: Restore
categories.description: Restoring system state when permitted by resilience eligibility.
